items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Sansec also noted an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1 addressed in this bulletin.

items.title: Adobe Commerce | Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce (CVSS score of 9.1) could result in privilege escalation, allowing an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction.

items.title: Adobe Commerce | Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) that could allow a high-privilege attacker to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including those that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Attacks have been observed on 79.5% of all stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, or gain unauthorized access to store data.
